references.title: Ali et al. (2007), Reliability and validity of two tests of soccer skill
references.population: 24 first/second university-team and 24 third/fourth university-team players
references.measurement: LSPT 16 passes; reported overall times include penalties
references.comparability: No exact LSPT/LSST reproduction; the MFL wall sequence has different geometry, scoring and familiarisation.

references.title: Wen et al., Measurement properties and feasibility of the LSPT
references.comparability: Reliability and population context caution; not a target quota for MFL.

references.title: Asimakidis et al. (2024), Assessment of Strength and Power Capacities in Elite Male Soccer
references.population: Senior professional and elite youth males over 17, kept distinct
references.comparability: No jump or strength normative calibration in PR184.

references.title: Lockie et al. (2017), A methodological report: adapting the 505
references.measurement: Traditional 505 described as 10 m approach plus 5 m to turn and 5 m return
references.comparability: MFL start x20, gate x30, turn x35, return gate x30. No limb plant, footwear or familiarisation equivalence.
